title: Canonical T4H runtime naming topology: Bridge, COUX, Arete, Factor, packs and agents
summary: Codifies the updated naming and layer separation for T4H runtime, orchestration, governance, environments, cognition, economic truth, capability packs and agent workforce taxonomy.

runtime_execution_layer.name: The Bridge
runtime_execution_layer.role: Runtime transport, repair, execution fabric and continuity substrate
runtime_execution_layer.notes: Owns all-time repair, transport, runtime continuity, callable execution and evidence-producing runtime pathways.

runtime_execution_layer.name: Orchestrator
runtime_execution_layer.notes: Use Orchestrator, not Conductor. Conductor is not canonical for this layer.

runtime_execution_layer.name: COUX
runtime_execution_layer.notes: Routes, coordinates and sequences operational execution.

runtime_execution_layer.name: FED-COUX
runtime_execution_layer.notes: Coordinates multi-runtime, multi-agent and cross-environment orchestration.

runtime_execution_layer.name: Trojan Oz
runtime_execution_layer.role: HITL embodied endpoint behind the Bridge
runtime_execution_layer.notes: Represents Troy/HITL as endpoint behind bridge, not the generic orchestrator.

agent_workforce_taxonomy.name: Neural Ennead
agent_workforce_taxonomy.notes: Strategic cognition collective and high-level work-family intelligence topology.

agent_workforce_taxonomy.name: Named 1000
agent_workforce_taxonomy.notes: Named specialist operational crew above anonymous worker agents.

agent_workforce_taxonomy.name: 10K Agents
agent_workforce_taxonomy.notes: Autonomous execution workers used for distributed workload execution.

environment_governance_layer.name: The Pen
environment_governance_layer.notes: Canonical ingress, intake, upgrade and write-forward path.

environment_governance_layer.name: Free-zer
environment_governance_layer.notes: Gatekeeper equivalent; freezes, validates and governs promotion.

environment_governance_layer.name: Symbio
environment_governance_layer.notes: Development/runtime factory and messy build environment.

environment_governance_layer.name: Synapse
environment_governance_layer.notes: Production cognition and locked runtime environment.

cognitive_institutional_layer.name: ThrivingOS
cognitive_institutional_layer.notes: Operational cognition OS, not a narrow orchestration layer.

cognitive_institutional_layer.name: Arete
cognitive_institutional_layer.role: Portfolio state graph and excellence topology
cognitive_institutional_layer.notes: Replaces Atlas. Arete means excellence of any kind / living up to full potential. Used for graph intelligence, maturity state, portfolio topology and capability progression.

cognitive_institutional_layer.name: Control Tower
cognitive_institutional_layer.notes: Oversight and monitoring interface, not the execution engine.

cognitive_institutional_layer.name: Reality Ledger
cognitive_institutional_layer.notes: Evidence-backed reality state and current truth ledger.

cognitive_institutional_layer.name: MRI
cognitive_institutional_layer.notes: Produces reports, recommendations, intelligence packs and executive outputs.

cognitive_institutional_layer.name: Factor
cognitive_institutional_layer.role: Canonical data, finance, research, grant and economic truth home
cognitive_institutional_layer.notes: Factor is broader than a data layer. It may own finance, research, grants, evidence linkage, economic proof, portfolio economics, telemetry and canonical truth.

capability_packs_runtime_modules.classification: Needs further refinement but accepted as the working category for deployable capabilities and runtime modules.

examples.name: RatPak
examples.notes: Correct spelling is RatPak, not RadPack.

examples.name: ObservabilityPack
examples.notes: Telemetry, monitoring and operational visibility capability.

capability_packs_runtime_modules.boundary_rule: Packs are not orchestration engines. COUX/FED-COUX orchestrate; packs provide deployable capability domains.

canonical_sentence: The Bridge carries execution and repair; COUX and FED-COUX orchestrate; the Orchestrator acts; Trojan Oz represents HITL behind the Bridge; The Pen ingresses; Free-zer governs promotion; Symbio builds; Synapse runs production; Factor holds economic and canonical truth; MRI reasons and reports; Arete maps portfolio excellence; ThrivingOS binds the institutional operating system.

non_canonical_or_replaced_terms.replacement: The Bridge for runtime transport; COUX/FED-COUX for orchestration; Orchestrator for active execution actor

bridge_instruction: Record this naming topology into the canonical asset/system registry. Route to Bridge for governance processing. Create/update registry rows for each named layer, mark evidence_state PARTIAL until Supabase registry/evidence receipt and Free-zer validation are produced. Do not promote to Synapse until Free-zer confirms no naming collisions and canonical references are updated.
